description:
Navigate to the 'Cartesian Coordinates' activity in GCompris and complete Level 1. 

Starting from the main menu:
1. Click the Mathematics category (Icon: Sheep/123).
2. Click the Geometry sub-category (Icon: Shapes/Compass).
3. Find and click the 'Cartesian Coordinates' activity (Icon: Grid with target or Tux).
4. Follow the instructions to identify points on the grid (e.g., click the point (X,Y) or enter coordinates).
5. Successfully complete the level until the congratulations animation appears or the level counter advances.
